protocol.timing: Each variant time includes allocation curve measurement and its solve/scoring. A split is measured once per rule and charged in full to each mode; partition time is separate. Add partition_sec for the full variant total; source-file loading and process/environment startup excluded. CSV times retain the existing millisecond rounding.
protocol.benders_comparison: Read the pinned parent sample, producing commit 9c6feeaf491e17f37ba486c65042daa43bf76132. Same exact inputs/budgets, Python environment and eight Gurobi threads; Benders runtime code is unchanged. Its separate-process single timings have a different execution order/warmup history, so no statistical speedup inference is made.
protocol.scope: Three easy existing slide cases, not the full 27-case cohort or real networks. No hardware; largest piece sizes are logical QUBO counts and not physical embedding/circuit-fitting evidence. Surrogate bounds are only for additive budget allocation, not global NIP.
